top_paper.title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
top_paper.summary: OpenART introduces a scalable red-teaming arena with evolving stateful environments to evaluate long-horizon AI agent safety, using the EMHA attack policy to expose increasing failure rates as task complexity grows.

papers.title: ReRound: Reconstructive Rounding to Resolve Midpoint Ambiguity in Calibration-Free LLM Quantization
papers.summary: ReRound uses a conditional diffusion model to guide rounding of near-midpoint weights during low-bit post-training quantization, selecting candidates by matching leading singular values to improve small LLM accuracy without inference overhead.

papers.title: Gaze Target Estimation Anywhere with Concepts
papers.summary: A new promptable paradigm integrates subject localization and gaze estimation into an end-to-end transformer model that uses text or visual prompts to identify subjects and predict gaze targets without multi-stage pipelines.

papers.title: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
papers.summary: Latent Dynamics Reasoning integrates kinematic dynamics in structured latent space to enable video world models that extrapolate physical laws far beyond training distributions with far fewer parameters and faster inference.

papers.title: SkillZip: Contract-Preserving Graph Compression for Scalable Agent Skill Libraries
papers.summary: SkillZip compresses reusable procedural skills into contract-preserving, executable graph units to enable efficient retrieval and expansion under limited context budgets.

papers.title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
papers.summary: Parameter-space exploration via perturbed policy sampling improves LLM reinforcement learning by diversifying rollouts and reducing training failures compared to action-space methods.

papers.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
papers.summary: Mechanist is an autonomous agentic system that uses AI to discover and control the mechanisms underlying model intelligence, generating hypotheses, performing causal interventions, and improving safety and performance.

papers.title: Ready Cohorts: Bounding GPU Opportunity and Avoiding Host Round Trips in LLM-Agent Control
papers.summary: Two studies define measurable GPU control gates for LLM-agent services by analyzing concurrent cohort scheduling and on-device routing versus host redispatch.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
papers.summary: SHAPER is a train-free framework that improves embodied agents by evolving reusable skills and a context-code harness around a frozen foundation model through environment rollouts.

papers.title: Poor Man's Agentic Modeling: Simulating Large LLM-Agent Societies on a Laptop
papers.summary: Replacing individual LLM agents with low-parameter surrogates fitted from cheap queries enables scalable society simulations, with validity predicted by an interaction-order and memory taxonomy.

papers.title: Simplex Relaxation for Discrete Diffusion
papers.summary: Simplax enriches uniform discrete diffusion via Dirichlet-categorical augmentation to improve reverse sampling and generative quality on text and Sudoku tasks.

papers.title: Hand Visibility Detector: Per-Keypoint Visibility Estimation for Hands
papers.summary: This work introduces a dedicated model for per-joint hand visibility estimation and demonstrates its benefit for multi-view 3D hand pose annotation.

papers.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
papers.summary: Genesis organizes long-horizon software development around a persistent project rather than persistent agents, enabling multi-day compiler construction and numerical module reimplementation with low cost and high performance.

papers.title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
papers.summary: OpenART introduces a scalable red-teaming arena with evolving stateful environments to evaluate long-horizon AI agent safety, using the EMHA attack policy to expose increasing failure rates as task complexity grows.

papers.title: AtlasVLA: Persistent World-Ego State Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary: AtlasVLA improves embodied AI by replacing reactive control with proactive reasoning via persistent world-ego memory, enabling robust long-horizon manipulation from a single wrist camera.

papers.title: Self-Geometry: GT-Free and Plug-and-Play Test-Time Adaptation for Geometrically Consistent 3D Vision Foundation Models
papers.summary: Self-Geometry improves vision foundation model predictions by enforcing explicit multi-view geometric constraints via test-time adaptation with LoRA, disentangled losses, and angular neighbor sampling.

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives
papers.summary: The study introduces a benchmark and formalizes narrative commitment preservation to evaluate long-horizon logical consistency in interactive storytelling with large language models.

papers.title: The Illusion of Visual Tool-Use: A Causal Audit of Thinking with Images
papers.summary: Visual tool-use in multimodal LLMs often lacks causal effectiveness, with returned observations frequently failing to influence answers or being used incoherently despite aggregate accuracy improvements.

papers.title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs
papers.summary: NeuPAT selectively constrains updates to language-sensitive neurons during multimodal tuning to preserve LLM language capabilities while enabling perceptual adaptation.

papers.title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
papers.summary: Stronger models can build inference-time harnesses that substantially improve weaker models' task performance without parameter updates by offloading reasoning into structured code and routing.

papers.title: From Synthesis to Removal: Physics-Grounded Reflection Simulation and Diffusion-Based Video Dereflection
papers.summary: A closed-loop framework combining physics-based video synthesis, diffusion-based video dereflection, and a new benchmark achieves state-of-the-art video reflection removal with fast inference.

papers.title: MBA: Multimodal Benchmark and Agents for Real-World Business Ideation
papers.summary: Researchers introduce MBA-Bench, a multimodal benchmark for business ideation agents, and propose MBA-b and MBA-k models trained with creativity and feasibility rewards via LoRA fine-tuning and group relative policy optimization, significantly outperforming text-only and multimodal baselines.

papers.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
papers.summary: The benchmark evaluates autonomous coding agents on open-ended world-model research by having them iteratively improve a starter model across game environments using a shared structured-state format.

papers.title: StateFlow: Building, Evolving, and Accessing 3D World States for Previsualization
papers.summary: StateFlow introduces a persistent 3D world state to enable iterative, controllable previsualization for film and game design by constructing, evolving, and accessing structured scene and camera representations.

papers.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract
papers.summary: Agent safety should be enforced at runtime through preventive controls and verifiable evidence rather than relying solely on training-time alignment methods.

papers.title: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
papers.summary: Spark-to-Paper is a lightweight, composable workflow inside coding assistants that generates research papers by separating planning from reporting, enforcing evidence-based claim revision, and using integrity checks to reduce fabrication.

papers.title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents
papers.summary: ToolHazard is a scalable framework that synthesizes adversarial environments to test LLM agents against indirect prompt injections, revealing vulnerabilities and improving defensive alignment.

papers.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
papers.summary: CoinRAG improves retrieval-augmented generation efficiency and accuracy by reusing fine-grained semantic nugget caches instead of full chunks.

papers.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
papers.summary: InSight-doc adaptively allocates visual resolution during reasoning to improve long-document understanding while reducing latency and hallucinations.

papers.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference
papers.summary: A new attention mechanism replaces fixed scaled dot-product attention with a learned power-law bilinear operator, with verified architecture, measured stability, and machine-checked proofs.

papers.title: 360CityArena: A Realistic Virtual Urban Navigation Benchmark for Embodied Agents
papers.summary: A new photorealistic urban benchmark reveals large performance gaps for embodied agents in city-scale navigation and spatial reasoning.
